findings.issue: The module docstring claims every bounded positive-definite function on an arbitrary involutive additive monoid is a moment function of a measure on bounded semicharacters; no topology, measurable structure, or semiperfectness assumption is present.

findings.evidence: All public results in the file use `[AddCommGroup V]` with no topology or continuity hypothesis; `sub_timeShift` concludes only `IsSemigroupGroupPD`.
findings.fix: Qualify the paragraph as applying only to the later topological/continuous BCR setting, rather than presenting measure representation as a consequence of the declarations here.

summary: Two module docstrings overclaim measure representations that require hypotheses absent from the documented declarations.
